strings.goal: Scenes, narration and output share one project.
strings.afterVoice: Regenerate affected audio after changing the script or voice settings.
strings.name: Nickname
strings.ruleNote: Enter amounts in BB. Total contributions include the current street. The pot is derived from contributions.
strings.voiceSource: Generate locally with IndexTTS or import external audio.
strings.audioUnsupported: Use WAV, MP3 or M4A audio
strings.noPlan: Fix the selected scene to preview
strings.voicePronunciationHelp: One term=pronunciation per line. Speech only; captions keep the original text.
strings.directionHelp: A mode saves the creative brief. Write or revise narration to match; customize or combine freely.
strings.sequenceHelp: List scene and branch entries in order; each starts from its own initial state. Use null or select a scene/branch to return to a single scene.
strings.timingHelp: Times are seconds from the start of this beat. One strictly increasing actions value per action; narration is the speech offset. Use null for action-then-speech.
strings.captionTimingHelp: Use start, end and text per cue, in seconds from speech start. Joined text must match narration. Use null for automatic paging.
strings.teachingPotOddsNote: A break-even threshold, not equity or call frequency.
strings.teachingPriceUnavailable: The simple river-call threshold does not apply here.
strings.teachingContext: The hand stays unchanged during analysis
strings.teachingCueHelp: Seconds from narration start, or beat start when silent. Reconfirm after replacing speech. Checked panels replace the visible list at that point.
strings.teachingReviewHelp: Confirmation records your review of the current conditions and script; it does not certify strategy correctness.
strings.teachingAdvanced: Edit full analysis material through the agent or scene setup.
strings.teachingReplayContext: Replay does not change the main hand

errors.default: Check the situation, selected language and poker actions.
errors.CARD_DUPLICATE: The same physical card cannot be used twice.
errors.BOARD_COUNT: The board length does not match the street.
errors.CHIP_AMOUNT: Use nonnegative chip amounts with at most two decimal places.
errors.OUT_OF_TURN: It is not this seat’s turn.
errors.ACTION_ILLEGAL: This action is not legal in the current situation.
errors.BET_SIZE: The total bet is outside the legal range.
errors.ROUND_OPEN: Finish this betting round before dealing.
errors.TRANSLATION_MISSING: Content is missing in the selected language.
errors.AUDIO_MISSING: Attach narration audio in the selected language.
errors.AUDIO_LOCALE: The audio language or duration does not match.
errors.REVISION_CONFLICT: The situation changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.REQUEST_CONFLICT: This operation ID was used for another edit.
errors.VOICE_NOT_READY: Install the local IndexTTS engine using the README.
errors.VOICE_FAILED: Voice generation failed; existing audio is kept. See project evidence for details.
errors.VOICE_CANCELLED: Voice generation cancelled; existing audio is kept.
errors.VOICE_SETTINGS: Check speed, emotion values and pronunciation syntax.
errors.VOICE_UP_TO_DATE: Selected narration already has current audio.
errors.VOICE_LANGUAGE: This voice engine does not support the selected language.
errors.AUDIO_STALE: Script or voice settings changed. Regenerate or import audio.
errors.VOICE_TIMEOUT: Voice generation timed out; existing audio is kept.
errors.DIRECTION: Complete the mode brief and its language fields.
errors.PATTERN_UNKNOWN: Mode not found; choose an available mode.
errors.SEQUENCE: Check the sequence scenes and branches.
errors.TIMING: Action times must increase and match every action.
errors.TIMING_COLLISION: Actions collide at this frame rate; separate their times.
errors.BEAT_AMBIGUOUS: This beat repeats; specify an entry or exact frame ID.
errors.CAPTION_TIMING: Check caption timing, overlap and measured speech length.
errors.CAPTION_TEXT: Timed captions must preserve the narration text.
errors.CAPTION_STALE: Speech changed; review and rebind precise caption timing.
errors.AUDIO_PLAYBACK: Speech playback failed. Check the audio and retry.
errors.TIMING_STALE: Speech changed; review and confirm this language’s action timing.
errors.PRESENTATION: Check the surface and visible analysis panels.
errors.PRESENTATION_TARGET: Focus must reference a currently visible card or player.
errors.PRESENTATION_TIMING: Cues must increase in time and fall within this passage.
errors.PRESENTATION_STALE: Speech or language changed. Review and confirm reveal timing.
errors.ANALYSIS_UNKNOWN: Choose analysis material from this scene.
errors.ANALYSIS_ROUTE: The referenced decision is not on this route.
errors.ANALYSIS_FUTURE: This passage cannot show a future decision or card.
errors.ANALYSIS_UNREVIEWED: Review the current conditions, analysis and related script.
errors.ANALYSIS_STALE: The hand or assumptions changed. Review analysis and related narration.
errors.ANALYSIS_CALCULATION: This decision does not meet the selected calculation’s conditions.
errors.ANALYSIS_RANGE_BLOCKED: A range combination conflicts with known cards.
errors.VARIANT_REVIEW: Conditions changed in this variant. Review related content.
errors.VARIANT: Choose a new scene and an existing legal action to replace.
errors.ANALYSIS_SCHEMA: Check the analysis fields and selected-language text.
errors.ANALYSIS_NODE: The referenced decision or action no longer exists.
errors.ANALYSIS_DUPLICATE: Analysis IDs must be unique within a scene.
errors.ANALYSIS_RANGE: Check the range player, groups and candidate combinations.
errors.ANALYSIS_EVIDENCE: Strategy material needs a source and applicable model.
errors.ANALYSIS_REVIEW: Use confirmation to record review of the current material.
errors.EVIDENCE_PATH: Use a regular file under evidence with no symbolic links in its path.
errors.EVIDENCE_MISSING: The evidence file cannot be read. Restore it before confirming.
errors.EVIDENCE_UNBOUND: Confirm the analysis to bind its current evidence file.
errors.EVIDENCE_CHANGED: The evidence file changed. Review conclusions and confirm again.
errors.COURSE_ORDER_REVIEW: The programme differs from the course order. Review prerequisites, repetition and answer disclosure.
